description_good_justification: The README starts with what VirtoMir is: a web UI for KVM/QEMU/libvirt that installs on an existing Linux host.
interact_justification: The README explains how to install it (Install), give feedback, report bugs and contribute (Contribute).
contribution_requirements_justification: https://github.com/onurbaydas/VirtoMir/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md (commit style, tests required, small pull requests).
documentation_basics_justification: README (install, first steps), docs/features.md and docs/try-in-a-vm.md.
documentation_interface_justification: The REST API is described by OpenAPI at /api/v1/openapi.json; the Terraform provider and Ansible collection have their own docs.
sites_https_justification: GitHub, GitHub Pages (demo) and the apt/rpm repositories are served over HTTPS only.
english_justification: Code, docs, issues and commits are in English.
repo_interim_justification: Every commit between releases is public on main.
repo_distributed_justification: Git, mirrored to GitLab and Codeberg.
version_unique_justification: Every release has a unique version (vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH).
version_tags_justification: Each release is a git tag (v1.2.2, ...).
release_notes_vulns_justification: Security fixes are listed in the release notes and published as GitHub security advisories (SECURITY.md).
report_responses_justification: Bug reports are answered by the maintainer.
enhancement_responses_justification: Feature requests are answered in Issues and Discussions.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: SECURITY.md commits to an answer within 72 hours.
build_justification: go build and npm run build; scripts/build-release.sh builds the release.
build_floss_tools_justification: Go, Node.js, npm, Vite: all FLOSS.
test_justification: Go unit tests (go test ./...) and Vitest UI tests (npm test), documented in CONTRIBUTING.md.
test_invocation_justification: Standard invocations: go test ./... and npm test.
test_most_justification: Go packages under internal/ and the UI helpers have tests; risky paths are tested live before releases.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: GitHub Actions runs all tests on every push and pull request (.github/workflows/ci.yml).
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md: new behaviour in internal/ comes with a Go test; UI helpers with a Vitest test.
tests_are_added_justification: Recent changes added tests, e.g. host-limit checks, peer join, fuzz tests.
tests_documented_added_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md and AGENTS.md require tests for new behaviour.
warnings_justification: go vet, svelte-check (npm run check) and shellcheck run in CI.
warnings_fixed_justification: CI fails on any warning from these tools.
warnings_strict_justification: go vet with and without the pam build tag, TypeScript strict mode, the race detector.
know_secure_design_justification: Least privilege (roles, scoped API tokens), secure defaults (TLS, pinned cluster keys), input validation on every API call.
know_common_errors_justification: Maintainer knows the OWASP Top 10 and the issues of a root daemon (path traversal, command injection, CSRF); see SECURITY.md scope.
crypto_published_justification: Only published algorithms: TLS, SHA-256, ECDSA, RSA, TOTP (RFC 6238).
crypto_call_justification: Uses the Go standard library (crypto/tls, crypto/rand, crypto/sha256); no own crypto.
crypto_keylength_justification: TLS 1.2+ with Go defaults; generated keys are ECDSA P-256 or RSA 2048 or larger.
crypto_working_justification: No broken algorithms (no MD5/SHA-1/DES/RC4) for security.
crypto_pfs_justification: Go crypto/tls uses ECDHE key exchange.
crypto_password_storage_justification: VirtoMir does not store sign-in passwords: users sign in with their Linux account (PAM), LDAP or OIDC. API tokens and recovery codes are random high-entropy secrets stored only as SHA-256 hashes.
crypto_random_justification: Secrets, tokens and keys come from crypto/rand.
delivery_mitm_justification: Releases over HTTPS from GitHub; apt/rpm repositories are signed.
delivery_unsigned_justification: Checksums are retrieved over HTTPS and packages are verified by signed repository metadata.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No unpatched vulnerabilities of medium or higher severity known for more than 60 days; Dependabot and CodeQL are enabled.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: SECURITY.md: serious issues fixed normally within 30 days.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: No credentials in the repository; secrets live in GitHub Actions secrets. GitHub secret scanning is on.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL (Go and JavaScript/TypeScript) on every push and weekly, go vet and svelte-check in CI, OpenSSF Scorecard.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: CodeQL alerts are triaged and fixed.
static_analysis_often_justification: On every push and pull request.
dynamic_analysis_justification: Go fuzz tests (join codes, qemu-img output parsing) and the Go race detector in CI.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: Written in Go and TypeScript, which are memory-safe.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Tests run with the race detector enabled.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: Fuzz and race findings are fixed before release.
